hooks.name: Update Live Documentation
hooks.description: After a spec task completes, updates durable steering docs and the README roadmap to match the new state.

action.prompt: A spec task just completed. Update DURABLE documentation to reflect real changes — do NOT touch AGENTS.md volatile state (the global-project-orchestrator skill owns the Kanban board and handover log). Specifically: (1) if a limitation listed in .kiro/steering/project-overview.md is now resolved, remove or update it; (2) if an ADR-worthy decision was made, add it to .kiro/steering/architecture-decisions.md; (3) if an iOS feature landed, update .kiro/steering/ios-testflight.md status; (4) if stem separation progressed, update .kiro/steering/stem-separation.md; (5) tick completed items in the README.md Roadmap. Only update what actually changed, and run the markdown linter on any file you edit. Do not rewrite docs that are still accurate.
